messages:
marco: Incident detected — APAC canary is returning 503s, spike in KV cache evictions. Pausing all rollouts for now. @ops_lead can you confirm hold and propose next steps?

deploybot: DeployBot: Canary health check failed for service=inference-apac zone=apac-2. All scheduled rollouts paused automatically. See runbook: https://intra.redwood/runbooks/canary-fail

sre_jen: I see 3/8 inference nodes in that ASG returning 503. KV cache eviction rate up x6 after last kernel tweak. Agree with pause. Need to swap traffic out of apac-2 and pin the stable variant.

ops_lead: On it — will start swapback to eu-west and apply a pin. ETA ~20m for traffic reroute. Recommendation: pin slot to v2.3.1 (build 20240312-2) and abort remaining canary buckets until we validate KV fix.

carmen: If we pin, let's create a hotfix branch for the APAC regression and document in the release notes. @marco can you open the hotfix PR?

marco: Yep — creating hotfix branch hotfix/apac-503 and applying pin on canary slot. Rollback candidate prepared (v2.3.0 fallback). Pin name: canary-2024-03-12 -> v2.3.1.

deploybot: DeployBot: Pin applied by marco -> slot=canary-2024-03-12 pinned_version=v2.3.1. Traffic rerouted: apac-2 -> eu-west-1a. Logs: /deploy/logs/4132106789-pin and /deploy/logs/4132106789-swapback

alice: Metrics check: eu-west latency/err rates back to baseline. APAC still elevated but not all nodes affected. Recommend resuming the change window tomorrow 03:00 UTC with strict canary ramp and rollback thresholds.

sre_jen: Pre-resume checklist I will own: 1) apply KV cache tuning (config patch rolled) 2) set aggressive alarm thresholds for 5xx and p95 token latency 3) smoke test harness run in APAC before ramp.

ops_lead: Ops plan: swapback complete, slot pinned, hotfix PR created, monitoring hooks in place. If incident extends >1h, we notify customers and postpone full rollout. I'll update the release calendar and release notes summary: "Hold due to APAC canary 503s; pin applied; resume target 03:00 UTC next day."

marco: :thumbsup: Thanks team. I'll post a short note in #incidents and in the release channel with the pin and new window. Reopen this thread if anything regresses.
